trainer.name: Diego
trainer.dialogueBefore: Camper Diego: My Aipom scouts ahead with that clever tail of its. Let's see how it battles!
trainer.dialogueAfter: Camper Diego: Aipom's tail is better at pointing the way than at fighting, it seems.

trainer.name: Tori
trainer.dialogueBefore: Picnicker Tori: Psyduck has had a headache ever since we came underground. Maybe a battle will shake it off!
trainer.dialogueAfter: Picnicker Tori: It's still holding its head. I think we both need some daylight.

trainer.name: Cassidy
trainer.dialogueBefore: Lass Cassidy: Buneary's ears pick up every footstep in the dark. It heard you coming ages ago!
trainer.dialogueAfter: Lass Cassidy: Buneary heard you coming, but it couldn't stop you. Oh well!

trainer.name: Wayne
trainer.dialogueBefore: Youngster Wayne: Ponyta's mane is my lantern down here, and it battles too!
trainer.dialogueAfter: Youngster Wayne: Keep a light with you in here. Without one, every tunnel looks the same.

trainer.name: Reginald
trainer.dialogueBefore: Hiker Reginald: My two Geodude roll along behind me like a pair of boulders. Stand aside, or battle!
trainer.dialogueAfter: Hiker Reginald: Rolled flat! You've a sturdy team there.

trainer.name: Lorenzo
trainer.dialogueBefore: Hiker Lorenzo: Onix bores through rock as if it were cheese. Let's see it go through you!
trainer.dialogueAfter: Hiker Lorenzo: Not through you, it seems. You're made of sterner stuff than rock.

trainer.name: Ana
trainer.dialogueBefore: Picnicker Ana: Hoothoot sees just fine in the dark. It spotted you long before I did!
trainer.dialogueAfter: Picnicker Ana: Hoothoot's bobbing its head like a clock. It's telling me it's time we went home.

trainer.name: Parker
trainer.dialogueBefore: Camper Parker: I came in here exploring, and look, I've found a challenger! Buizel, Shinx, let's go!
trainer.dialogueAfter: Camper Parker: Exploring's easier than battling. I'll go back to drawing my map.

trainer.name: Terry
trainer.dialogueBefore: Collector Terry: See my Gible? I found it in this very cave. Isn't it rare? Now watch what it can do!
trainer.dialogueAfter: Collector Terry: Rare isn't the same as strong, I suppose. I'll keep polishing its scales.

trainer.name: Gerald
trainer.dialogueBefore: Ruin Maniac Gerald: A cave this deep must hide something ancient. While I search, how about a battle?
trainer.dialogueAfter: Ruin Maniac Gerald: Beaten! Still, I'll keep digging. Something old is down here, I can feel it.
